example.en: It is of no use in understanding obesity.
example.zh: 它对理解肥胖毫无用处。

labor of love.zh: 出于热爱而做的事（不图回报）

example.en: earners, work is a labor of love.
example.zh: 对于收入高的人来说，工作是一件出于热爱的事。

labor of love.note: 句子残缺（earners 前被截断）；英式拼写 labour

example.en: But are we really in need of more protein?
example.zh: 但我们真的需要更多蛋白质吗？

in need of.note: 与 in need 相关，in need 单列

example.en: Now that design education is limited in the curriculum, I’m all in favour of competitions.
example.zh: 既然设计教育在课程中受到限制，我完全支持举办竞赛。

in favour of.note: 例句为截断句，已补句号；美式拼写 in favor of

example.en: Strive to make sense of some unknown forces.
example.zh: 努力弄懂一些未知的力量。

example.en: I’ve never heard of it, but I do know little Lawrence loves cartoons.
example.zh: 我从没听说过它，但我知道小劳伦斯喜欢卡通片。

example.en: The increase in new housing falls short of the demand of the growing homeless population.
example.zh: 新增住房的数量满足不了不断增长的无家可归人口的需求。

example.en: Out of habit.
example.zh: 出于习惯。

out of office.zh: （Out of Office 邮件生成器）外出，不在办公室

example.en: Why did the author and his colleagues launch the Out of Office Email Generator?
example.zh: 为什么作者和同事推出了“外出邮件生成器”？

out of office.note: 两句都是产品名 Out of Office Email Generator，不是在讲短语本义，建议作废（或仅在日后单独出现 out of office 时再收）

example.en: It provides refugees with a wide range of courses free of charge.
example.zh: 它免费向难民提供大量课程。

example.en: attitude, but those who aren't as genetically gifted aren't necessarily out of luck.
example.zh: 那些遗传上没那么有天赋的人不一定就没希望。

example.en: Not to think highly of her qualifications when promoted or given a pay raise.
example.zh: 升职或加薪时不看重她的资历。

example.en: We should stay persistent even in face of failures.
example.zh: 即使面对失败，我们也应该坚持。

in face of.note: 原写法 in face of 为缺 the 的写法，规范为 in the face of；此句也常见 in face of

example.en: More and more people are treating pet cats like their children.
example.zh: 越来越多的人把宠物猫当孩子对待。

more and more.note: 形容词/副词比较级重复式，另 less and less 同类

example.en: What does he do to strengthen his muscles and all that?
example.zh: 他做什么来增强肌肉之类的？

example.en: We consider some clothes to be powerful some to be fun, and so on.
example.zh: 我们认为有些衣服显得有力量，有些显得有趣，等等。

example.en: At my well-respected, private, four-year university in Washington, D.C., which boasts a yearly tuition of $44,046 not including room and board, I receive over $57,000 yearly in financial aid.
example.zh: 我就读于华盛顿特区一所声誉很好的四年制私立大学，年学费高达44046美元（不含食宿），而我每年得到超过57000美元的助学金。

example.en: They are less and less indifferent to it.
example.zh: 他们对此越来越不冷漠了。

less and less.note: 句1中 less and less of a presence 为名词性用法（越来越少的存在感）

example.en: better habits day-in and day-out, continual progress will be the logical outcome.
example.zh: 如果天天养成更好的习惯，持续的进步就是必然结果。

day in and day out.note: 连字符写法 day-in and day-out 已并入；两句都是片段

example.en: I’ve read some financial education books, done some online learning, and have spoken to my nearest and dearest for
example.zh: 我读过一些理财书，做过一些线上学习，还和我的亲人们聊过。

one's nearest and dearest.note: 原句被截断，结尾不完整

example.en: the terms and conditions that require agreement when using new software products.
example.zh: 使用新软件产品时需要同意的条款和条件。

example.en: Talking on and on about what’s interesting to you isn’t going to make you an interesting person, she says.
example.zh: 她说，不停地谈论你感兴趣的事并不会让你成为有趣的人。

example.en: Today, a greater and greater proportion of people living on the streets are there because of bad luck or a series of mistakes, or because the economy forgot them—they lost a job or were evicted or fled an abusive marriage just as the housing market was growing increasingly unforgiving.
example.zh: 如今，越来越多的街头流浪者是因为运气不好或一连串失误。

greater and greater.note: 只是「比较级 and 比较级」的普通重复结构（同 bigger and bigger），非固定短语；如需保留可统一并入「比较级 and 比较级」

example.en: The schools don’t have to pay anything to take part in the Design Ventura competition.
example.zh: 学校参加 Design Ventura 比赛不需要付任何费用。

example.en: But the bike lanes were a done deal, and soon they were in place.
example.zh: 但自行车道已成定局，很快就建好了。

in place.note: 句0/1 为同一句被拆开

example.en: The findings show: in principle, most people view it more ___28___ when workers are replaced by other people than by
example.zh: 研究结果显示：原则上，大多数人认为用其他人取代工人时更……（空格）

in principle.note: 唯一例句是完形填空，含空格 ___28___ 且句子被截断；建议人工换句

example.en: In truth, natural flavors do not _28_ much, at least chemically speaking, from their flavor-boosting _29_: artificial flavors.
example.zh: 说实话，天然香料与其增味的……人工香料，在化学上并没有太大区别。

in addition.zh: 此外；另外（in addition to 意为除…之外）

example.en: In addition to tuition, college students have to pay extra fees for the courses they take.
example.zh: 除了学费，大学生还要为所选课程额外付费。

in addition.note: 含 in addition 与 in addition to 两种用法，合并在一条

example.en: It brought in the most advanced instruments.
example.zh: 它引进了最先进的仪器。

bring in.note: 字面“带进来”与“引进”混用，整体按引申义收

example.en: In contrast, they felt less judged by members of their own group.
example.zh: 相比之下，他们感觉自己群体的成员对他们的评判较少。

example.en: In fact, we need blue light during the day to be healthy.
example.zh: 事实上，我们白天需要蓝光才能保持健康。

example.en: No injuries were reported in connection with the fire.
example.zh: 没有与这场火灾有关的人员受伤报告。

in connection with.note: 原句后接 [2] 另一句，已截取前半句

example.en: They could become a rare treat in the near future.
example.zh: 它们在不久的将来可能变成稀罕的享受。

example.en: He later handed them in to the Cologne police.
example.zh: 他后来把它们交给了科隆警方。

example.en: She didn’t sign up for membership in time.
example.zh: 她没有及时注册会员。

example.en: Decided on this year’s energy assistance package of $8 billion in total.
example.zh: 今年决定的能源援助方案总共80亿美元。

in total.note: 例句为省略主语的片段

example.en: They will find they have something in common.
example.zh: 他们会发现彼此有共同点。

example.en: The city’s council and ScottishPower have announced a range of strategies in an attempt to reduce carbon emissions ahead of the new national target of 2045.
example.zh: 市议会和苏格兰电力公司宣布了一系列策略，试图在2045年新国家目标之前减少碳排放。

example.en: In short, natural flavors are _32_ from plants and animals to create specific flavors for processed foods.
example.zh: 总之，天然香料是从植物和动物中……（空格）出来的，用来为加工食品创造特定风味。

example.en: A police spokeswoman said that officers were currently in attendance at the scene.
example.zh: 警方发言人说，警员目前已在现场。

example.en: Send in applications before Friday.
example.zh: 周五前把申请寄来。

come in.zh: 名列（第几）；（价格等）为；出现；到来

example.en: In the following two years, Red Rum lost out on the title, coming in second both times.
example.zh: 在接下来两年里，赤朗姆没能夺冠，两次都屈居第二。

come in.note: 4句含义分散（位次/价格/进来/出现），其中“带着钱进来”接近字面方向，整体仍保留；拿不准是否过杂

example.en: Begin seeing moving images and characters in action.
example.zh: 开始看到活动的影像和角色。

in action.note: 例句为去掉编号 “— 9” 的片段

example.en: When in the presence of an unknown student from their own university, only 12 per cent of students selected the healthier option.
example.zh: 当有来自本校的陌生学生在场时，只有12%的学生选择了更健康的选项。

in the presence of.note: 原句后接 [17] 另一句，已截取前半句

example.en: In particular, dangerous conditions such as icy roads or wet ground could cause difficulty for drivers.
example.zh: 尤其是结冰的道路或潮湿的地面等危险状况，可能给司机带来困难。

a slap in the face.zh: 当面打脸，侮辱；严重的冒犯

example.en: Not welcoming children under ten is a complete slap in the face to families.
example.zh: 不欢迎十岁以下的孩子，对家庭来说是彻头彻尾的侮辱。

example.en: In other words, we’re all really, really stressed.
example.zh: 换句话说，我们都压力很大。

example.en: In any case, it’s
example.zh: 无论如何，它是……

in any case.note: 唯一例句被截断，需人工确认；原卷 cet4_2025_12_2

example.en: Just make sure you’re logged in.
example.zh: 只要确保你已登录。

example.en: To them, a difference, no matter how small in your eyes, signals the end of the relationship.
example.zh: 对他们来说，无论在你眼中多么微小的差别，都标志着关系的结束。

in the eyes of.note: 例句为 in your eyes 变体；另一句 in the eyes of key observers 含完形空格

example.en: Do you have anything in mind?
example.zh: 你心里有什么想法吗？

in mind.note: 常见搭配 have sth in mind / bear in mind

example.en: Research by Amanda Lenhart of the Pew Research Centre, a US think tank, found that the most passionate texters are also the kids most likely to spend time with friends in person.
example.zh: 皮尤研究中心的阿曼达·伦哈特的研究发现，最热衷发短信的孩子也最可能当面和朋友相处。

example.en: It is not in fashion any more.
example.zh: 它已经不流行了。

example.en: Early on, the web is their “third space”, but by the late teens, it’s replaced in reaction to greater independence.
example.zh: 网络起初是他们的“第三空间”，但到了十几岁后期，它因为更大的独立性而被取代。

in reaction to.note: in + reaction + to 意思可由字面推出，是普通搭配，非固定短语；建议作废

example.en: But you can get 25% off if you sign up in advance.
example.zh: 但如果你提前报名，可以打七五折。

example.en: “It’s going to feel like a made-up conversation that people don’t necessarily want to tune in to.
example.zh: 这会让人觉得像是编造的对话，人们不一定想去收听。

example.en: Fraudsters also invest in pay-per-click advertising to feature at the top of search engines when people type in phrases such as “Spanish seaside villas”.
example.zh: 骗子还投放按点击付费的广告，让人们输入“西班牙海滨别墅”等词语时，自己的广告排在搜索结果顶部。

type in.note: type + in 接近字面方向，但 type in 在词典中作“输入”整体记忆，保留

example.en: This in turn helps us become better negotiators and abstract thinkers.
example.zh: 这反过来又帮助我们成为更好的谈判者和抽象思考者。

in turn.note: 句3 为 in turns（轮流/交替），与前三句略异

example.en: How those decreases will be felt will depend on the degree of warming and the crop in question, but in general, “anything over about 30°C is very bad for crops,” says Wolfram Schlenker, an associate professor of international and public affairs at Columbia University.
example.zh: 这些减产将如何体现，取决于升温幅度和所涉作物，但总的来说……

in question.note: 例句较长；与 in general 在同一句出现

example.en: compared to 3 percent for Queens in general.
example.zh: 而皇后区整体为3%。

in general.note: 句1 为“in general 对整体”用法；例句为片段

factor in.zh: 把…考虑进去，把…计算在内

example.en: Have you factored those in?
example.zh: 你把这些都考虑进去了吗？

example.en: In essence, each driver would constantly make adjustments to keep their car roughly halfway
example.zh: 从本质上说，每位司机都会不断调整，让自己的车保持在大约中间的位置。

example.en: “Fathers may fare better than mothers in part due to how they spend time with their children,” said lead author Katherine Nelson-Coffey.
example.zh: “父亲们比母亲们表现更好，部分是因为他们陪孩子的方式。”主要作者凯瑟琳·尼尔森-科菲说。

in part.note: 句0 被拆开，part 单独成行

example.en: Please bear in mind that the price includes moving all the furniture, and the whole task would take two days.
example.zh: 请记住，价格包括搬所有家具，整个工作需要两天。

bear in mind.note: 与 keep in mind 同义，各自单列

example.en: I can’t remember his name, but he’s written three books in all.
example.zh: 我记不起他的名字，但他一共写了三本书。

in all.note: 例句截取原句前半，去掉了星号书名部分

take in.zh: 吸收，摄入；理解，接收（信息）

example.en: I’m very much dependent on vision as a way of taking in information.
example.zh: 我非常依赖视觉来获取信息。

take in.note: 句1 为摄入热量，句0 为接收信息

example.en: A skilled backroom operator who speaks without a filter, Ecclestone said often that in his opinion, the sport was at its best when he was allowed to act as "a dictator.
example.zh: 一位说话毫无顾忌的幕后操盘手埃克莱斯顿常说，在他看来，这项运动在他能像“独裁者”一样行事时最好。

check in.zh: 登记入住；办理登机手续

example.en: Now, all I need is to photocopy your passports and then I can get you all checked in and show you to your rooms.
example.zh: 我现在只需要复印你们的护照，就可以帮你们办好入住并带你们去房间。

example.en: Do you prefer to fill out an application on the web, or to print it out and fill it in by hand and then post it back to us?
example.zh: 你喜欢在网上填写申请表，还是打印出来手写填好再寄给我们？

fill in.note: 句0 为“填补空白”，句1 为“填写”

a kick in the pants.zh: 当头一棒，催促（促人行动的刺激）

example.en: psychological boost, or the proverbial kick in the pants.
example.zh: 心理上的提振，或者说俗话讲的“当头一棒”。

example.en: I have now come to realize that being boring, in actuality, is not only about who you are as a person, but also how you present yourself.
example.zh: 我现在意识到，无趣实际上不仅关乎你是怎样的人，也关乎你如何展现自己。

example.en: Willpower and habits go hand in hand.
example.zh: 意志力和习惯是相辅相成的。

example.en: To help employees in need adapt to the new work environment.
example.zh: 帮助有需要的员工适应新的工作环境。

in need.note: 句0 实为 in need of，已在 in need of 条目；此条建议保留 those in need 类用法

example.en: The position was completely in line with my degree.
example.zh: 这个职位与我的专业完全对口。

in line with.note: 例句为原句中的一个分句（原句很长）

example.en: So he is insane to give in to her like that.
example.zh: 所以他竟然那样向她让步，真是疯了。

example.en: It is important to keep in mind that personal space varies depending on culture and context.
example.zh: 重要的是要记住，个人空间因文化和场合而异。

keep in mind.note: 与 bear in mind 同义，各自单列

example.en: Fall in love with boredom and focus
example.zh: 爱上无聊，专注当下。

example.en: In that case, then.
example.zh: 那样的话，那就这样吧。

example.en: In reality, education does an aging brain good.
example.zh: 实际上，教育对衰老的大脑有益。

in reality.note: 句0、3 为同一句被拆开

in the business of.zh: 从事…行业；以…为业，致力于

example.en: Universities today are in the business of making money, and mine is no exception.
example.zh: 如今的大学是在做赚钱的生意，我所在的大学也不例外。

in the business of.note: 常以 be in the business of doing 的形式出现
